blendVariants.label: Corojo
blendVariants.title: The Wise Man Corojo Lancero
blendVariants.summaryHtml: Cedar, cinnamon, graham cracker, honeyed peanut, nutmeg and natural sweetness drive a woody, spice-led profile. The Nicaraguan Corojo '99 wrapper keeps the 40-ring smoke aromatic and wrapper-forward, with a brighter and less cocoa-heavy character than the Maduro.
blendVariants.noteHtml: The exact 7″ × 40 Corojo Lancero scored 91 points in Cigar Insider in November 2025, with an easy draw and a medium-strength profile.
productionLines: Handmade in Nicaragua at My Father Cigars
Binder: Nicaraguan tobaccos from Estelí and Jalapa
Filler: Nicaraguan tobaccos from Estelí, Condega and Jalapa
practicalLines: Cut cleanly into two ~3½″ × 40 half-sessions before lighting
